entries.228c75089a66ad8d: This business consists of design, construction supervision and construction contracting for new housing and other buildings carried out by Mitsui Home Co., Ltd. and its FC companies, and renovation and renewal work carried out by Mitsui Designtec Co., Ltd. This is one of the few contracting-type businesses in the group, which receive construction orders from clients and carry out the work; revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥247,300 million, and construction orders received were ¥131,294 million. Mitsui Home Co., Ltd. is advancing research and development in wooden construction, and has its original construction method “MOCX WALL” and a wooden condominium “MOCXION”.

entries.db7683e3ba55cb8f: This category operates facilities directly, carrying out hotel and resort businesses and sports and entertainment businesses. Mitsui Fudosan Hotel Management Co., Ltd., Mitsui Fudosan Resort Management Co., Ltd., and Shima Resort Management Co., Ltd. mainly operate by leasing facilities owned by Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd., and MITSUI FUDOSAN AMERICA, INC. operates resort and luxury facilities in Hawaii, United States. Tokyo Dome Corporation ([[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiary]], voting rights 80.0%) operates stadium and arena businesses centered on Tokyo Dome City. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥244,146 million.
entries.dce85b3cc0ba2d07: This is the sale of condominiums and detached houses in Japan. Completed inventory at the end of the period was 46 units.

entries.ee65f24e716a9248: This category covers the new-build contracting business and others. Mitsui Home Co., Ltd. and its FC companies provide design, construction supervision and construction contracting for new housing and other new buildings, and Mitsui Designtec Co., Ltd. carries out home renovation work and renewal work for offices and commercial facilities. In addition, there are subsidiaries engaged in golf course operation, retail of flowers, seedlings and gardening supplies, and specified electricity transmission and distribution and heat supply businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥288,257 million.

entries.f14259b1a74b64c0: This business sells condominiums and detached houses to individual customers, and sells rental housing, office buildings and other properties to investors. Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. itself sells business facilities and other properties; Mitsui Fudosan Residential Co., Ltd. sells detached houses and mid- and high-rise residential buildings and other properties; and TID PTE.LTD., MITSUI FUDOSAN AMERICA, INC. and MITSUI FUDOSAN (U.K.) LTD. conduct property sales businesses in Singapore, the United States and the United Kingdom. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥729,271 million, and segment profit (business profit) was ¥193,182 million, the largest profit of the five segments.
